title: A snipe's private escalation outlives its own 60 s swap deadline: the deadline is set once when the swap is built and every attempt re-signs the same calldata, while each attempt takes about 52 to 64 s, so at default settings a snipe that does not land gets 1 or 2 real attempts of its budget of 4, its fee never escalates to the planned 3 and 4 gwei, and it fails clean on a relay simulation refused as UniswapV2Router: EXPIRED, with a reason that does not mention the deadline and a remediation telling the operator to raise MEV_BUY_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI

evidence.note: V2 snipe (handleNewPairForChain): deadline = now + 60 s, computed once before the buy is submitted
the V2 txBuilder handed to submitBuyTx closes over that one deadline
V3 snipe (handleNewV3PoolForChain): the same now + 60 s, the SwapRouter02 multicall deadline at :1435
submitBuyTx = withNonceLock(wallet, () => sendTxWithRetry(txBuilder, ctx)) with no explicit budget, so 4 attempts (src/utils/txManager.ts:107-108)
sendTxWithRetry calls txBuilder() once and hands that one transaction to the strategy, which runs every attempt with it
each attempt's populatedTx is ...txRequest with only the gas limit, nonce and fees set, so the calldata and its deadline never change (bloxroute.ts:118 and passthrough.ts:87 do the same)

each attempt is simulated first (eth_callBundle); a revert throws 'Flashbots simulate: tx would revert (' + (firstRevert.error || firstRevert.revert) + ')', so the reason says 'execution reverted' and the revert data naming EXPIRED is not decoded
each attempt waits a 45 s confirm window (poll 4 s) after its first target block, so one attempt takes about 52 to 64 s, about the whole deadline
escalated fee = step x (attempt + 1): 1, 2, 3 and 4 gwei planned for a snipe; at default settings only the 1 and 2 gwei attempts are ever sent

emitSnipeFailClean: reason = the thrown message; attempts is the constant 4 (:369) whatever was sent; the remediation names MEV_BUY_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI (:382), a ceiling that never binds here (the fixed wording is AUD-BUY-037)

evidence.ref: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project realpath test/realpath/triage/AUD-TX-003.test.ts (Node 22.16.0, 2026-11-12; realistic reverts are the simulated chain default since 780d67d; three runs of the triage folder at 150bb1e)
evidence.note: asserted after the AUD-TX-003 marker: the non-landing V2 snipe (token B) sends 2 bundles at one nonce carrying one decoded deadline; attempt 2's eth_callBundle is refused (flashbots.simulate.revert attempt 2) at the time of buy.snipe.fail-clean; the decoded deadline is earlier than that simulation and not earlier than attempt 0's not-landed; the fail-clean reason is 'Flashbots simulate: tx would revert (execution reverted)'; the fail-clean comes 90 to 120 s after B's first submission (104.6 s measured by fixer A)

evidence.ref: Phase 23 code-review fixer A measurement (worktree fix23-A, Node 22.16.0, 2026-11-12; a temporary probe, removed before commit): the 2026-11-11 AUD-TX-029 snipe flow with realistic reverts, bundles never included, each target block 12 s after its bundle
evidence.note: the snipe sent 1 bundle (1 gwei); attempt 0 not-landed at 64 520 fake ms; attempt 1's eth_callBundle at 64 540 ms was past the swap deadline (launch + about 60 s) and refused (UniswapV2Router: EXPIRED, flashbots.simulate.revert attempt 1); buy.snipe.fail-clean at 64 540 ms with reason 'Flashbots simulate: tx would revert (execution reverted)'; no mev.escalation.ceiling-hit line

evidence.ref: Phase 23 code-review fixer A measurement (worktree fix23-A, Node 22.16.0, 2026-11-12; a temporary probe, removed before commit): a V2 stop-loss private sell (MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS default 2) with a router sell read that enforces the deadline, each target block 12 s after its bundle
evidence.note: attempt 0 ends at about 64 s and attempt 1's simulation is refused as expired, so the sell gets one real private attempt before the public fallback; with the target block 2 s after its bundle both attempts fit inside the deadline (AUD-TX-029's test)

sibling_sites_checked: Every swap built for a private escalation, at 23a6461 and at HEAD 150bb1e (src unchanged at these sites except a two-line shift in bot.ts and exitEngine.ts). (1) The V3 snipe (bot.ts:1382, multicall deadline now + 60 s, the same submitBuyTx budget of 4): the same mechanism, a code read, not measured. (2) The deliberate buy's private leg (bot.ts:544 privDeadline now + 60 s, DELIBERATE_BUY_PRIVATE_ATTEMPTS default 2 at :557, escalatePrivateBuy under the nonce lock at :558): the same mechanism with a budget of 2; its second attempt is refused when the first ends past 60 s, and the leg then goes to the no-double-buy guard and the public leg (a code read). The deliberate public leg (bot.ts:731, deadline now + 600 s) is one public transaction built just before it is sent: not affected. (3) Private sells: buildV2SellTx and buildV3SellTx compute now + 60 s inside the builder (exitEngine.ts:362, :399), but sendTxWithRetry calls the builder once, so they are the same. Routine sells (MEV_SELL_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS default 2, exitEngine.ts:453-456, via :788) lose their second attempt when the first ends past 60 s (measured by fixer A on V2); a V2 sell then goes to the public fallback with a fresh 600 s deadline (exitEngine.ts:551) and completes, while a V3 sell has no public fallback and takes the no-fallback return of AUD-EXIT-007 after one real private attempt instead of two (a code read). Anti-rug sells make one private attempt (privateAttemptBudget 'anti-rug' = 1), built and sent at once: not affected. Partial sells (exitEngine.ts:1531, sendTxWithRetry's default budget of 4) are like the snipe (a code read). (4) Other strategies: bloxroute.ts:118 and passthrough.ts:87 also reuse the built transaction for every attempt and simulate each one with provider.call (bloxroute.ts:137, passthrough.ts:121), so an attempt past the deadline is refused there too (a code read); on BSC every bloXroute attempt waits the full 45 s confirm window. (5) The fail-clean line: its fixed wording and attempts 4 for any cause are AUD-BUY-037; the ceiling-versus-budget wording is AUD-TX-029; the wrong knob name is AUD-TX-010.
severity_rationale: S2 by operator ruling of 2026-11-12 (process note PN-002); capital_impact none. A correctness and robustness defect in the snipe's main inclusion lever: each private attempt (first target block, stats call, 45 s confirm window) takes about as long as the whole 60 s deadline, so the escalation and its fee steps are mostly dead weight at default settings. A snipe that does not land gets 1 or 2 real attempts of 4 and bids no more than 2 gwei, then fails clean with a reason that names neither the deadline nor EXPIRED and a remediation (raise MEV_BUY_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI) that cannot help, because the fee ceiling never binds. No capital is lost, stranded, overspent or exposed by this defect itself: the snipe spends nothing, and a V2 private sell falls through to the public fallback with a fresh deadline. The indirect effect is on V3 exits: a routine V3 private sell whose first attempt runs past 60 s gets no second attempt before the no-fallback return that strands the position (AUD-EXIT-007 is that strand's own finding; a code read here). That indirect effect and the misleading remediation are why it is S2 rather than S3.
recommendation: Phase 29 (S2). Make the deadline fit the escalation: rebuild the swap (a fresh deadline and, for a buy, a fresh quote and minimum output) for each attempt by passing the builder into the strategy instead of one built transaction; or keep one deadline and end the escalation cleanly before an attempt that cannot be included in time, sizing the attempts and the confirm window to fit it; and decide whether a snipe should keep retrying at all once its launch window has passed. Decode the relay's revert data so a refusal names EXPIRED, and have the fail-clean line report the attempts actually sent and a remediation for the actual cause (with AUD-BUY-037, AUD-TX-029 and AUD-TX-010). The AUD-TX-003 lock-hold time depends on this (about 105 s today); re-measure it with the fix. Behavior-changing, so Phase 29 decides the shape (no decision card exists yet). No triage test of its own: the mechanism is asserted after the AUD-TX-003 marker. Nothing is fixed in Phase 23.
reported_by: claude (Phase 23 code-review fixer A, WR-01 re-triage)

traces.scenario: A V2 snipe on ETH whose bundles are never included (default settings; a relay that refuses an expired swap; the AUD-TX-003 test's token B, times from B's first submission)
steps: t=0: handleNewPairForChain builds swapExactETHForTokens with deadline = now + 60 s (bot.ts:1043) and calls submitBuyTx; sendTxWithRetry builds the transaction once (txManager.ts:113)
attempt 0 (1 gwei): simulated (accepted), sent, first target block, stats call, 45 s confirm window: not-landed at about t=52 s
attempt 1 (2 gwei): the same calldata, simulated just inside the deadline, sent, not-landed at about t=105 s

attempt 2 (3 gwei planned): the relay's eth_callBundle refuses the same calldata (UniswapV2Router: EXPIRED, the deadline passed at about t=60 s); flashbots.simulate.revert attempt 2; the strategy throws

buy.snipe.fail-clean: reason 'Flashbots simulate: tx would revert (execution reverted)', attempts 4 (a constant), remediation 'raise MEV_BUY_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI ...'; zero ETH spent; the wallet lock was held about 105 s (AUD-TX-003)
traces.outcome: 2 of 4 attempts sent, at 1 and 2 gwei of the planned 1 to 4; the operator is told the snipe exhausted its inclusion and to raise a fee ceiling that never bound, with no word of the deadline. With the first target block 12 s after its bundle, attempt 0 ends at about 64 s and only 1 bundle is sent.
